title: Can I drive in Latvia using my Indian driving licence?
shortAnswer: An Indian licence is not automatically valid for long-term driving in Latvia.
answer: Visitors may drive only under conditions permitted by Latvian law. Students staying long-term should verify whether they must exchange or obtain a Latvian driving licence depending on their residence status.
tips: Carry your passport or residence permit.

title: Is an International Driving Permit required?
shortAnswer: It depends on your licence and your legal status in Latvia.
answer: Many visitors carry an International Driving Permit together with their national licence. Long-term residents should verify current legal requirements before driving.
tips: The original licence is also required.

title: What side of the road do people drive on?
shortAnswer: Vehicles drive on the right side of the road.
answer: Traffic in Latvia keeps to the right. Overtaking is generally performed on the left unless road signs indicate otherwise.
tips: Take extra care during your first few days.
Watch for tram tracks in Riga.

title: How do I buy a bus or tram ticket in Riga?
shortAnswer: Tickets can be purchased using official public transport channels.
answer: Passengers should purchase or activate a valid ticket before or immediately after boarding according to the transport operator's rules.
tips: Always validate your ticket if required.
Keep it until your journey ends.

title: Do students receive transport discounts?
shortAnswer: Many eligible students can receive discounted public transport.
answer: Discount eligibility depends on student status and municipality requirements. Check your university and the transport operator.

title: Should I sign a rental agreement?
shortAnswer: Yes. Always use a written rental agreement.
answer: A written agreement protects both the tenant and landlord. Read all conditions before signing.
tips: Photograph the apartment before moving in.

title: Should I pay cash before seeing an apartment?
shortAnswer: No. Be cautious of advance-payment scams.
answer: Avoid sending deposits before verifying the landlord, property and rental agreement.

title: Can international students work while studying?
shortAnswer: Employment depends on Latvian immigration regulations and residence permit conditions.
answer: Students should always verify their work rights according to their residence permit and current immigration rules.

officialSources.name: Office of Citizenship and Migration Affairs

title: Should I register with my university after arrival?
shortAnswer: Yes. Complete all university registration steps promptly.
answer: Most universities require identity verification, residence information and student registration after arrival.

title: What happens if I travel without a valid ticket?
shortAnswer: Passengers may be subject to penalties according to transport operator rules.
answer: Ticket inspectors may request proof of a valid ticket. Penalties are determined by the transport operator's regulations.
tips: Keep it until you leave the vehicle.
